gameInfo.title: Goblin Slayer — Persistent Goblin Sandbox
lossConditions: Complete loss of the house and Elena without escape

player.name: Unnamed
player.description: Wolf- and bear-touched adult male goblin. Heavily conditioned, now with layered variant traits: enhanced senses from wolf, greater mass, density, strength, tougher skin and claws from bear. Still goblin in height and basic form.

stats.notes: Significantly denser and stronger. Tougher hide. Accelerated healing. Enhanced senses.

bearTraits: Greater overall mass and density (broader, heavier frame)
physiology.combinedNotes: Traits compressed into goblin form. No height increase or full transformation. Noticeably thicker and more powerful. Bed creaks under weight. Elena has observed the changes.

inventory.name: Wolf Variant Pelt Blanket
inventory.description: Thick dark pelt, dried and usable as blanket.

inventory.name: Bear Variant Pelt Blanket
inventory.description: Massive, heavy dark brown-black pelt worked into a thick blanket by Elena. Large enough for two. Faint wild scent.

skills: Enhanced stealth and tracking via senses

elena.disposition: deepened dependence / passive acceptance with caution toward changes
elena.notes: Continues caretaking. Has treated major wounds and worked both pelts. Noted physical thickening.

Isolated Frontier House.description: Occupied. Both wolf and bear pelt blankets finished. Large meat stores from recent hunts.

eventsLog: Killed bear variant after difficult fight.
Consumed raw bear heart. Intense fever and growing pains.
Gained bear-touched traits: mass, strength, tougher skin, claws.
Elena finished bear pelt into heavy blanket.

elena.name: Elena
elena.description: Slim adult human woman with dark brown hair and D-cup breasts. Passive dependent. Has skinned and finished both variant pelts into blankets and tended severe wounds.

history: Wolf-touched then bear-touched via raw hearts.
Major wounds from bear fight healed with Elena's care and accelerated recovery.
